source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check vendor tool could be use
Use vendor tool to check the TPM function
1. Execute the tool.
2. In the tool manu, perform a full TPM test.
3. After test, select the get test result.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: The test result has completed and no error state shown. (0001FFFF)

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Collect TPM device, kernel and tpm2_selftest evidence over SSH while the operator runs the licensed vendor full-TPM menu test.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: TPM2 supplemental output plus operator vendor-test result.
deepseek_columns.risk: The vendor TPM test is interactive; generic TPM2 evidence is only supplemental.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly separates the interactive vendor test from supplemental tpm2-tools checks but lists the wrong package as if it enabled the named test.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; requires the exact vendor tool, full-test effects and authoritative meaning of 0001FFFF before execution.
historical_reviews.round_02: No separate exact-code round-02 entry was found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: Confirms that tpm2_selftest is not equivalent to the named vendor full test and that unknown TPM state effects are safety-critical.

original_test_intent: Run the specified vendor's full TPM functional diagnostic on the identified TPM and establish that the test completes with the exact accepted result state, while proving that TPM ownership, keys and platform security were not unintentionally changed.
original_method: Use the licensed vendor tool's interactive menu to launch its full TPM test and retrieve the result, preserving the raw status including 0001FFFF; use read-only platform and TPM2 inventory only as supplemental correlation, not as a replacement.
manual_activity: If the case is unblocked, a qualified operator will have to drive the named vendor menu and attest the displayed result. The agent may collect supplemental read-only TPM evidence and analyze artifacts, but no execution is safe until the vendor test semantics are resolved.
required_inputs: Exact TPM/platform identity and licensed vendor diagnostic package/version/hash
Vendor procedure for the named full TPM test and every operation it performs
Authoritative definition of result code 0001FFFF and the complete PASS/error mask
TPM ownership/key/secure-boot state-impact statement plus recovery-key/security backup
Qualified GUI/operator access, maintenance authorization and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not run while 0001FFFF semantics or the vendor full-test state changes are unknown.
Do not clear or re-own the TPM, delete or generate persistent keys, change hierarchy authorization or alter secure-boot state as improvisation.
Do not substitute tpm2_selftest or device enumeration for the licensed vendor full test.
Preserve raw security evidence and do not auto-retry after any vendor-tool or TPM error.
agent_execution_scope: Request and validate the vendor tool, status decoder, TPM identity and state-impact/recovery documents.
Before later execution, collect non-mutating TPM/platform baseline and prepare an evidence matrix for the operator-run vendor test.
After artifacts exist, compare raw vendor result and supplemental TPM2 evidence while leaving the verdict to the engineer.
engineer_actions: Obtain authoritative vendor confirmation of 0001FFFF and full-test operations.
Approve security backup/recovery and perform the vendor UI test only after re-review.
Determine the formal verdict from the complete vendor and platform evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its TPM enumeration, dmesg and tpm2_selftest probes can provide supplemental read-only evidence, but they do not execute the named vendor full test or decode 0001FFFF. The tpm2_getdevices spelling may also be environment/version dependent and must not be assumed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No execution command is approved while blocked. After vendor semantics are supplied, retain the exact vendor menu procedure and separately use validated read-only TPM inventory commands only for correlation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Vendor full-test menu, result retrieval, 0001FFFF marker and 30/5-minute fields are preserved; no generic TPM2 substitution is accepted.

modernized_recommendation.status: NO MODERNIZED EXECUTION UNTIL VENDOR SEMANTICS RESOLVE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Re-review against the signed vendor procedure and result-code table, then capture a target-bound vendor transcript plus before/after TPM properties, ownership, persistent-handle and secure-boot state under an approved security backup plan.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the exact TPM, firmware and vendor-tool combination covered by the authoritative documentation.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Required vendor diagnostic manual and status-code definition were not present; no external substitute was used.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Would add state-impact controls and exact decoding while retaining the vendor full test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No substitution or reduction is allowed; TPM2 self-test remains supplemental.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Vendor semantics, decoder and recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: TPM ownership or key changes can break measured boot, disk unlock and security services; an unexplained hex value cannot support acceptance.

project_override_considerations: A project may supply the licensed tool and authoritative code/state semantics, which triggers re-review. It may not declare generic tpm2-tools evidence equivalent to the vendor full test or waive security recovery controls.
expected_evidence: TPM/platform identity, vendor tool/license/version/hash, signed full-test procedure and authorization
Authoritative 0001FFFF decoder and explicit state-change boundary
Operator-attributed complete vendor menu transcript and raw result plus supplemental read-only TPM evidence
Before/after TPM ownership/key/secure-boot and BMC/SEL state, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criterion both point to the same vendor full TPM test and its result. The fatal issue is missing authoritative semantics and safety behavior, not a contradiction between source fields.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Execution cannot be judged safe or accepted because neither the meaning of 0001FFFF nor the full test's effect on TPM ownership/keys/security state is defined. This is unresolved operation and acceptance semantics, not merely a missing package or ordinary expected-value input.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its useful supplemental evidence boundary but rejects PARTIAL and the implication that tpm2-tools enables equivalent execution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees that genuine semantic and security uncertainty requires BLOCKED pending authoritative vendor material.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: States the exact unblock conditions and avoids converting the blocker into a permanent tool-availability problem.

review_improvement: Protects TPM ownership and keys, rejects a non-equivalent self-test substitution and makes the unexplained acceptance code an explicit re-review gate.
independent_technical_reasoning: A missing package alone would be readiness, but this case lacks the meaning of its sole acceptance code and whether the requested full test mutates security-critical TPM state. Those unknowns prevent safe execution and valid interpretation, so BLOCKED is justified until authoritative vendor semantics are supplied.
